proof_body:
by
  intro b n hb
  have h : (b : ℤ) ≡ -1 [ZMOD ((b + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)] := by
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
    exact ⟨-1, by push_cast; ring⟩
  have := Nat.ofDigits_zmodeq' (b : ℤ) (-1) (b + 1) h (Nat.digits b n)
  rw [Nat.ofDigits_neg_one, ← Nat.coe_ofDigits, Nat.ofDigits_digits] at this
  simpa using this
target_source: ∀ (b n : ℕ), 2 ≤ b → (n : ℤ) ≡ ((Nat.digits b n).map (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℤ))).alternatingSum [ZMOD ((b : ℤ) + 1)]
